headline: The Asian Development Bank approved a $250 million policy-based loan to help Pakistan strengthen its public-private partnership system and prepare bankable infrastructure projects, Dawn reports.

card.desc: To help prepare market-ready infrastructure projects

caption:
ADB approves a $250 million loan for Pakistan! 🏗️
According to Dawn, the Asian Development Bank on Wednesday approved a $250 million policy-based loan to help Pakistan strengthen its public-private partnership (PPP) system and build a pipeline of bankable, sustainable projects. The financing supports reforms to prepare market-ready, cost-efficient infrastructure projects and improve fiscal risk management. It is the second phase of the Promoting Sustainable Public-Private Partnerships Programme; with ADB support, the government has approved a medium-term PPP pipeline for 2026-2030.
